title: CT lesion foundation model assesses hepatocellular carcinoma aggressiveness and recurrence
summary: A CT lesion foundation model was pretrained by self-supervised learning on 32 120 generic lesion and 6387 HCC-specific patches. Across one internal and two external cohorts it reached AUCs of 0.916, 0.846 and 0.920 for microvascular invasion and 0.833, 0.885 and 0.795 for pathological grade. Its risk score stratified recurrence-free survival with an externally validated C-index of 0.701.
